seal.statement: A partition transaction is the same transaction on every replica: PREPARE ends speculative staging and is acknowledged only after the participant group has committed and applied a replicated PREPARE command carrying exact identity, epoch, deterministic operations and conflict evidence; COMMIT applies those operations, the immutable terminal outcome and the applied index in one application transaction through the existing committed-entry owner, idempotently under replay and refusing conflicting content or outcome reversal; ROLLBACK terminalizes without applying; no staged row is readable before consensus; the participant answers exact durable outcomes so that NO_TRANSACTION or a missing session is never read as COMMITTED; the coordinator persists one immutable decision before COMMIT fanout and no timeout, lost answer or expiry can select rollback after it or erase PREPARED; recovery and CDC obligations survive the request deadline and a crash after data commit. One-phase and two-phase transactions are both covered.

Independent design vet (Opus subagent, checkout 282944876b83fa51ec7b97c11c7553274224f06b; report in session scratchpad design-vet-tx1-leg-a-282944876.md): VERDICT revise, design-leg-a-2026-10-10.md is NOT accepted for implementation. Shape agreed (replicated PREPARE row, decision applied by the committed-entry owner, staging ended before proposal, PREPARED never erased). Blockers: late PREPARE after ROLLBACK and no 1PC end state (needs a committed ROLLBACK tombstone per transaction key, first terminal applied wins); no fence on the write set between PREPARE and COMMIT (2PC) and an isolation regression for 1PC (BEGIN IMMEDIATE today holds the single connection); the conflict check has no durable replicated input (rowCommitEpoch/committedWriteLog are leader-only and never rebuilt; write-set key null without a primary-key predicate); APPLY_FAILED edge contradicts itself (separate deterministic failures settled under a SAVEPOINT from single-replica host failures; after PREPARED a failure must be impossible); outcome reads on a lagging/restarted leader answer NOT_PREPARED from volatile state (R10); the transaction key (sessionId default 'default', per-coordinator epoch seeded from now()) is not unique and the epoch is not on the wire for PREPARE/COMMIT/ROLLBACK; uncited existing authorities reconstructPreparedState (transaction-base :104-174) and hasPendingPreparedTransactions (snapshot-checkpoint-store :208) scan the log for PREPARE fields; staged rows remain visible to every reader of the shared SQLite connection, so ending staging before proposal does not deliver receipt 1 (dirty read during staging reproduced by probe). Defects: await mechanism unspecified (markers carry no entryId; 30 s pending deadline; non-leader refusal); participant never told 1PC vs 2PC; two durable tables for one terminal fact and UPSERT overwrites; CDC dedup relied on does not exist; split/merge mirror bypassed by transaction operations; digest must use the JSON codec's canonical form; per-operation entryId dedup is global so a transaction could apply partially; the note prescribes coordinator behaviour (NOT_PREPARED rule, reenter decision owner) across the query seam; superseded sealed tests/contract not listed (partition-transaction.property 12/13/15, session-transaction-isolation W6, partition-service.test 365-410, distributed-transaction-coordinator 770-800, partition-session-transaction-persistence-admission). P1/P2 as written cannot turn green under a correct design (they await commitTransaction before the port commits) and the receipt producer maps P2 to the atomicity receipt it does not measure. Receipt ids: add write-set fence, leader change/restart after PREPARE, late-PREPARE/1PC end-state; split #5/#7/#8 by owner; rename #2; #6 is query-lane only. Healthy path: 2PC goes from 0 to 2 awaited consensus rounds per participant plus the query lane's decision write, 1PC 0 to 1 (minimum for correct replicated 2PC). Thirteen next red witnesses listed in the report. Next step: revise the design note and the witnesses before any participant source change; register a coordinator-participant coupled pair in impact-contracts; agree the seam with the query owner.

The uniform sealed coordinator-COMMIT-before-fanout promise conflicts with 1PC apply-time conflict refusal; query and participant owners must explicitly resolve intent versus final decision or prepare-first semantics and supersede any changed acceptance meaning. Resolve the literal no-staged-row-readable promise against owning-transaction read-your-writes explicitly. F6 c-prime is synchronous savepoint/replay/rollback, not a private DB; it still owes deterministic values, snapshot validity, bounded replay and a durable PREPARE reservation. Do not block committed-log apply on a conflicting command while waiting for a later releasing COMMIT in the same log. A fresh absent PREPARE row cannot prove noncommitment against delayed commands. Carry exact stable identity/mode/fences/content across the real query wire and preserve identity in outcome answers. Reconcile current-backend recovery/snapshot, terminal authority, batch atomicity, topology mirroring and CDC owners. P1/P2 must start COMMIT without awaiting its ACK, drive the proposal/committed application, then await completion; P2 does not yet prove outcome/applied-index atomicity, and its new-index duplicate is not restart replay. P1's positive proposer assertion follows the failing baseline assertion and is not an independently reached control. Retain eight sealed receipt IDs and original reds; add subevidence where meaning is unchanged, never relabel uncovered evidence green.

Independent design vet round 2 (Opus subagent, read-only checkout a9d45cf50; report design-vet-tx1-leg-a-v2-a9d45cf50.md in the session scratchpad): VERDICT REVISE, 19 blockers. Accepted: F6 c-prime isolation, non-stalling partition reservation, ROLLBACK tombstone, UNKNOWN for absence, 1PC left to the query owner, receipt 8 red, test-driven consensus in the witnesses. Blockers: (1) P1/P2/P3 exercise the legacy session-only shape (no PREPARE, no transactionId, operations on the commit marker) so they cannot go green under the design and go green under the rejected rev-1 mechanism; (2) atomicity receipt greenable by applying operations+outcome in a second transaction after the apply transaction; (3) P3 plants follower-only divergence and calls a single-replica failure success, and misstates its own red; (4) deterministic COMMIT failure reachable after global COMMIT because PREPARE apply does not re-validate and the reservation starts only at PREPARE; (5) documented epoch snapshot isolation / first-committer-wins dropped without supersession; (6) deterministic results (changes/lastInsertRowid before commit, rowid/timestamp/random re-allocation on replay) unanswered; (7) REFUSED_RESERVED settles the entryId so a retried write can never succeed; (8) split/merge mirror claims false (mirroring is a proposer-side effect, replay excludes transaction commands, a cited file is missing); (9) COMMIT/ROLLBACK not bound to the coordinator decision or prepared digest on the wire; (10) transaction_id is tx-sessionId-now-seq, not unique; (11) two durable tables hold one fact and the outcome write is an overwriting UPSERT; (12) no state x command transition table and ROLLED_BACK is outside the shared outcome vocabulary; (13) await/ack mechanism (marker entryId, wait owner, deadline, leader-loss answers) unspecified; (14) refusing legacy requests breaks every current transaction or keeps a second path; option A supersedes the coordinator's sealed one-phase-never-prepares test; (15) many silent supersessions (dt6 fitness/zombie, reconstruction-leadership, W1/W2, Property 46/48, sql-workflow, partition-service.test 365-415: 93 baseline assertions in four files alone); (16) c-prime isolation has no witness; (17) hasPendingPreparedTransactions is legacy-path only and the rs-raft checkpoint has no prepared gate; (18) wrong citations (partition-write-metrics-base.js, durable-ready-loop:259, transaction-base:18, buildPartitionWriteEntry key order); (19) reservation unbounded under coordinator loss and the participant-to-coordinator reentry channel remains. Twelve red witnesses are listed in the report as required before any source change. Design revision 3 is required before participant implementation; blockers 9, 10, 14 cannot be resolved by the participant lane alone and need the query owner's seam agreement.
